title: XORM MustCols with In clause generates unsatisfiable zero-value predicate on Delete
answers: Why does annotation tag filtering still return tags that were removed from an annotation?
Why does xorm Delete with In and MustCols match zero rows?
How to use MustCols with an In condition in xorm without generating an unsatisfiable WHERE clause?
Why are removed tags not unlinked in annotation_tag when updating annotations?
body:
Symptom: Annotation tag filtering continues returning annotations for tags that were removed or replaced.
Root cause: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:xormRepositoryImpl.ensureTags included "tag_id" in MustCols alongside .In("tag_id", tagsDelete) on a bean with zero TagID, generating an unsatisfiable "tag_id = 0" WHERE clause.
Fix pattern: Omit columns with explicit .In(...) conditions from MustCols when executing xorm Delete with a struct bean.
Constraints: Applies when an explicit condition already filters the column; do not omit struct bean columns from MustCols if their zero value must be matched to prevent widening the query.
applies: xorm Delete calls combining MustCols with explicit In conditions
